description: A question passes retrieval if all expectedRetrievedClauses appear in topK retrieved chunks.
rules: If expectedRetrievedClauses is empty, the system should return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or NEEDS_REVIEW.
If expectedRetrievedClauses is non-empty, each required clause should appear in retrieved results.
Retrieved chunks must expose clauseId, chunkId, policyDocumentId, sourcePath, and similarity.
